title: What's Wrong with Your Synthetic Tabular Data? Using Explainable AI to Evaluate Generative Models
summary: Reproducibility code for a paper that fits detection models and applies interpretable/explainable ML (PFI, SHAP, counterfactuals) to distinguish real from synthetic tabular data generated by several methods (ARF, synthpop, TabSyn, CTAB-GAN+, CTGAN, TVAE). SDV's single-table module is imported directly in utils_dl.py to fit CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer as two of the compared generative models.
